## Description

What does this PR change? Why?

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation (changes to docs, README, or comments)
- [ ] CI / Infra (changes to CI, deployment, or infrastructure)

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the Butwal Hacks design system (no standard Tailwind color classes like `bg-gray-800`, use hex arbitrary values like `bg-[#FE0000]`)
- [ ] No inline styles used for colors (`style={{ backgroundColor: ... }}`)
- [ ] `npm run build` passes with zero errors
- [ ] TypeScript compiles cleanly (`npx tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] No AI generated text, placeholder data, or generic copy added
- [ ] New pages have metadata and/or `notFound()` for missing data
